# TypographyScale

`Flare.Components.TypographyScale`

Semantic type-scale roles mapped to semantic HTML elements and CSS utility classes.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `DisplayLarge` | `0` | Display Large - largest display text, maps to h1. |
| `DisplayMedium` | `1` | Display Medium - maps to h1. |
| `DisplaySmall` | `2` | Display Small - maps to h1. |
| `HeadlineLarge` | `3` | Headline Large - maps to h2. |
| `HeadlineMedium` | `4` | Headline Medium - maps to h3. |
| `HeadlineSmall` | `5` | Headline Small - maps to h4. |
| `TitleLarge` | `6` | Title Large - maps to h5. |
| `TitleMedium` | `7` | Title Medium - maps to h5. |
| `TitleSmall` | `8` | Title Small - maps to h5. |
| `BodyLarge` | `9` | Body Large - default body text, maps to p. |
| `BodyMedium` | `10` | Body Medium - default body text, maps to p. |
| `BodySmall` | `11` | Body Small - small body text, maps to p. |
| `LabelLarge` | `12` | Label Large - label text, maps to p. |
| `LabelMedium` | `13` | Label Medium - label text, maps to p. |
| `LabelSmall` | `14` | Label Small - smallest label text, maps to p. |
